question: How many nations (including EOR and ROC teams) participated in the 2020 Summer Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**206.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total number of participating nations in the** 2020 Summer Olympics** was **206**, which includes **11 athletes **from the** EOR team **and **335 athletes** from the ROC team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **EOR** stands for the **"Refugee Olympic Team",** which was established in **2016** to provide a platform for athletes who have been displaced from their home countries due to** war, conflict, or other reasons.**
 
• **ROC** stands for the **"Russian Olympic Committee"**, which was formed after **Russia was banned** from participating in the Olympics due to a state-sponsored doping scandal.
 
• **Athletes from Russia **were allowed to compete under the** ROC flag** and anthem, but **not** under the Russian flag or anthem.
